description: This file is a Java Spring MVC Controller class named 'ProductPriceController' responsible for handling admin-side product price management. It contains methods for viewing, editing, creating, saving, and removing product prices, and interacts with services like ProductService and ProductPriceService to manage product pricing data. The class also handles AJAX requests for paging product prices.

classes.name: ProductPriceController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller managing product pricing in admin interface, including CRUD operations and AJAX paging.

methods.name: getProductPrices
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the product prices page for a given product ID. Validates product ownership by store.

methods.name: pagePrices
methods.description: Processes POST AJAX requests to fetch a paginated list of prices for a product, returning data in JSON format.

methods.name: editProductPrice
methods.description: Handles GET requests for editing a specific product price, preparing data for the form.

methods.name: displayCreateProductPrice
methods.description: Displays form for creating a new product price for a specified product and availability.

methods.name: displayProductPrice
methods.description: Prepares model attributes for displaying the product price form, for both new and existing prices.

methods.name: saveProductPrice
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save or update a product price, including validation.

methods.name: deleteProductPrice
methods.description: Handles POST AJAX request to delete a product price by ID.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets active menu context in the model for view rendering.
